architecture_variations.name: One Arcade, Four Operations
architecture_variations.description: Curve, hinge, repeat and stretch the earlier arcade. Compare with a fixed miniature; turn two native dials and move the pink point. Visual study on a fixed courtyard floor; changing architecture has no collision.
interactions: Choose Source, Curve, Hinge, Field or Stretch.
Drag the pink point to move the hinge or canopy attachment.
architecture_variations.qfep_connection: A familiar assembly can retain its parts while its spatial relationships become unfamiliar. Geometric continuity does not itself establish a habitable or physically stable building.
architecture_variations.status: research prototype; desktop and supplied XRTools poses tested; no headset or structural simulation claim
